_doc: Music sourcing brief for music-forge. Bucket keys = the channel's mood taxonomy. Two registers: the casual-comedic idiom (casual-bed/upbeat/sneaky, Crayon-Capital, NOT cinematic) AND the restrained exposE-underscore register added 2026-07-17 (underscore=default con-spine bed, somber=elegiac tail) — present, credible, ~2-3 dB under VO, still NOT big cinematic stingers. Keys become audio-tokens.json music_pools keys; incompetech_seeds feed fetch_incompetech (CC-BY). dur_s = a loopable section length. This is the ONLY home for sourcing config; final beds live in audio/beds + music_pools.

casual-bed.mood_use: DEFAULT workhorse bed — wry, dry, laid-back groove (slightly noir/neutral, NOT cheerful) under most narration. Cheerful/bouncy is the 'upbeat' opt-in only; a super-cheerful bed under fraud/human-cost stories reads tonally wrong (register doctrine: default wry, cheerful opt-in).
clap_prompts: a laid-back bluesy noir detective-lounge groove
a smooth cool jazzy underscore that sits under narration

upbeat.mood_use: energetic playful lift — the fun/absurd money bits (still casual-comedic, not a fanfare). The non-meme euphoric options (Fig Leaf Times Two / Exhilarate / Ascending the Vale) are the DEFAULT market-mania lift; 'Monkeys Spinning Monkeys' stays in the pool for OCCASIONAL deliberate comedic use only (retrack 2026-07-17: it is meme-coded and undercuts the exposé register as a default).
clap_prompts: an upbeat cheerful playful comedic tune

underscore.mood_use: DEFAULT con-spine bed for the exposé register — a present, RESTRAINED instrumental underscore (understated pizzicato/strings/keys tension, soft mystery, noir investigation) that rides ~2-3 dB under VO and reads CREDIBLE, not comedic. This is the retrack (2026-07-17) that replaces the meme-coded `sneaky` cues (Sneaky Snitch / Scheming Weasel) as the default 'the con is running' bed. Restrained underscore, NOT big cinematic tension/stingers (that boundary still holds — see SKILL.md).
clap_prompts: a restrained understated instrumental underscore with subtle tension under narration
a credible pensive strings-and-keys bed for a documentary expose, not comedic

sneaky.mood_use: light comedic tiptoe / mischief — the 'here's the con' stretches (quirky, NOT cinematic tension). RETIRED as the default con-spine bed (2026-07-17 retrack): these are meme-coded (Sneaky Snitch / Scheming Weasel) and now kept for OCCASIONAL deliberate comedic use only; the restrained `underscore` bucket is the new default. Not deleted — the human allows deliberate use.
clap_prompts: a sneaky mischievous comedic tiptoe tune

somber.mood_use: elegiac / mournful tail for the button close and human-cost resolutions — a restrained, dignified solo-piano or gentle strings bed that lets the wistful close land. Credible, never comedic; used sparingly. (2026-07-17: added so the button no longer resolves on the comedic con bed.)
clap_prompts: a slow elegiac mournful solo piano underscore
a gentle dignified melancholy strings bed for a reflective ending
